_comment: Results may vary by account, region, and CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION setting.
Single source of truth: read by cortex_proxy.py (to serve /v1/models) and by
hermes_configure.py (to populate providers.<slug>.models in Hermes config).
Keeping them in two places would let them diverge silently.
Values are CONTEXT WINDOW in tokens, from
To refresh after a Snowflake model catalog change, run refresh_cortex_models.py,
which tests each name with a real call, detects tool-calling constraints, and rewrites this file.
python3 refresh_cortex_models.py --write --upload   # write and upload to stage
Do not add models manually without testing them: an invalid name returns HTTP 400
'unknown model', which Hermes reports as 'Context length exceeded'.
'tools_unsupported' describe two ways tool calling can be restricted;
the proxy handles the first automatically; the second is a model limitation:
agents that depend on tool calling cannot use models in 'tools_unsupported'. '_legacy'
lists models with a known EOL date.
_note_tools_reasoning: These models reject a request carrying 'tools' if reasoning_effort is not
explicitly "none": HTTP 400 'Function tools with reasoning_effort are not
supported'. Omitting it is NOT enough: the gateway applies a default and the request
fails anyway. All values tested: none -> 200; minimal -> 400 'invalid
request'; low/medium/high -> 400 on the tools+reasoning constraint.
Consequence: on these models reasoning and tool calling are mutually
exclusive. cortex_proxy.py forces reasoning_effort=none when tools are present, which for
an agent is the right choice (without tools it would be unusable), but it means
giving up reasoning. For prompts without tools, reasoning remains available.
The proxy also has an adaptive retry on that error message, so a future model
with the same constraint works without updating this list.
claude-* and openai-gpt-5.4 accept tools and reasoning_effort together without problems.
_note_context: openai-gpt-5.2, openai-gpt-5.4 and openai-gpt-5.5 are not in the limits table
in the documentation: declared at 272000 out of caution. Underestimating the context is
safe (Hermes compresses earlier than necessary); overestimating it produces upstream errors.
openai-gpt-5.5 is in Private Preview (PRPR) and openai-gpt-5.4 in Public Preview:
they may change or disappear without notice. Preview availability
varies by account, cloud and region: always verify on your own account.
openai-gpt-4.1 is LEGACY: legacy since 2026-08-12, EOL 2026-10-14. It will disappear soon.
openai-gpt-5.6-luna / -sol / -terra: MIND THE NAME. The catalog
SHOW CORTEX BASE MODELS lists them as OPENAI-1P-GPT-5.6-* ('1p' = first party), but the
name invocable on the gateway and in SQL functions is WITHOUT the '1p-' segment. With '1p-'
you get 400 'unknown model' over REST and 'is unavailable' over SQL.
Verified on 2026-08-17: they respond over REST and via AI_COMPLETE, max output 131072 tokens,
and they accepted an input of 450008 tokens (finish_reason stop) - so the window is
larger than the rest of the gpt-5 family. Declared 400000 out of caution.
Lifecycle NULL in the catalog: not yet officially released, they may disappear.
Availability is not uniform: on some accounts/regions the gateway remaps them to
openai-gpt-5.6-<name>-global, which comes back 'unavailable'. Verify with the gate.
